reviewed_inference.quantifiers: Fix alpha in(0,1). For every integer T above the fixed threshold there exists a possibly T-dependent convex1-Lipschitz differentiable loss sequence with actual OGD zero-comparator regret at least phi(alpha) T^(2-alpha)/2.
reviewed_inference.normalized_bound: Since T>0, for that same witness R_T(0)/T >= (phi(alpha)/2)*T^(1-alpha).
reviewed_inference.meaning: phi(alpha)>0 and1-alpha>0, so these lower certificates grow unbounded as T grows. Equivalently, for any proposed uniform sublinear regret guarantee over allowed loss sequences, sufficiently large horizons have counterexamples. This inference uses ordinary real-power algebra/growth, not a newly formalized Tendsto declaration.
